history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Asian man with curly dark hair and glasses stands in front of a white metal fence at night. He is wearing a black t-shirt, white pants, and a silver chain necklace. His right hand is resting on his chest. Behind him, a house with a brown roof and barred windows is visible, illuminated by a bright street lamp on the left side of the frame. The ground is paved with concrete. The overall mood is casual and relaxed, with a soft, diffused lighting from the street lamp creating a slightly moody atmosphere. The color palette is dominated by dark tones of the night, contrasted by the white fence, pants, and the bright light. The style is realistic, with a shallow depth of field that slightly blurs the background.
